description: Final summary figure: ITIH5 isoform targeting signals and alternative exon conservation
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
seqs={}
for iso in ["Q86UX2-1","Q86UX2-2","Q86UX2-3","Q86UX2-4"]:
    seqs[iso]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd(s,w=9):
    v=[KD[a] for a in s]; return np.array([np.mean(v[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(len(v))])

spans={"isoform 1\n942 aa":[(1,942)],
       "isoform 2\n694 aa":[(1,666),("alt",667,694)],
       "isoform 3\n728 aa":[("alt",215,218),(219,942)],
       "isoform 4\n244 aa":[("alt",450,473),(474,677),("alt",678,693)]}
SP=(1,16); VIT=(35,161); VWFA=(295,478)
phob=["SP yes (n2-13, c17/18), 0 TM","SP yes (n2-13, c17/18), 0 TM","no SP, 0 TM, all-cytoplasmic","no SP, 0 TM, all-cytoplasmic"]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15.5,10.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,4,height_ratios=[1.15,1.0,1.0],hspace=0.75,wspace=0.32,
                    left=0.085,right=0.985,top=0.9,bottom=0.07)
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
for i,(name,parts) in enumerate(spans.items()):
    y=len(spans)-i
    for p in parts:
        if p[0]=="alt": axA.add_patch(Rectangle((p[1],y-0.17),p[2]-p[1]+1,0.34,fc="#d69e2e",ec="k",lw=0.5))
        else: axA.add_patch(Rectangle((p[0],y-0.17),p[1]-p[0]+1,0.34,fc="#cbd5e0",ec="k",lw=0.5))
    cov=set()
    for p in parts:
        a,b=(p[1],p[2]) if p[0]=="alt" else p
        cov|=set(range(a,b+1))
    for (ds,de),col in [(SP,"#c53030"),(VIT,"#2f855a"),(VWFA,"#2b6cb0")]:
        if all(x in cov for x in range(ds,de+1)) and not any(p[0]=="alt" and p[1]<=ds<=p[2] for p in parts):
            axA.add_patch(Rectangle((ds,y-0.17),de-ds+1,0.34,fc=col,ec="k",lw=0.5))
    axA.text(1000,y,phob[i],va="center",fontsize=9.5,color="#9b2c2c" if i<2 else "#1a202c")
axA.set_xlim(-25,1560); axA.set_ylim(0.35,5.0)
axA.set_yticks([4,3,2,1]); axA.set_yticklabels(list(spans.keys()),fontsize=9)
axA.set_xlabel("position in canonical ITIH5 numbering (Q86UX2-1)",fontsize=9)
axA.set_xticks(range(0,1001,200))
for c,l in [("#c53030","signal peptide 1-16"),("#2f855a","VIT 35-161"),("#2b6cb0","VWFA 295-478"),
            ("#d69e2e","isoform-specific exon"),("#cbd5e0","shared canonical sequence")]:
    axA.plot([],[],"s",color=c,label=l)
axA.legend(loc="upper right",fontsize=8,frameon=False,ncol=1,bbox_to_anchor=(1.0,0.72))
axA.set_title("A   Isoform architecture and Phobius topology prediction",fontsize=11,loc="left",pad=8)

for k,(iso,s) in enumerate(seqs.items()):
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,k]); p=kd(s[:60])
    ax.plot(range(1,61),p,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.6)
    ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=0.9)
    ax.fill_between(range(1,61),1.6,p,where=(p>1.6),color="#c53030",alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_ylim(-3.6,4.2); ax.set_title(f"{iso}   max = {p.max():.2f}",fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel("residue",fontsize=8); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
    if k==0: ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (w=9)",fontsize=8)
fig.text(0.085,0.615,"B   N-terminal 60-residue hydropathy (dashed line 1.6: lower bound of a signal-peptide h-region)",fontsize=11)

cons=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(region="canonical exon 1 CDS\n(signal peptide)",phylop=0.521,alignable=23,nonprim=11),
 dict(region="isoform 3\nalt first exon",phylop=-0.327,alignable=19,nonprim=0),
 dict(region="isoform 4\nalt first exon",phylop=-0.169,alignable=31,nonprim=10),
 dict(region="shared internal exon\n(positive control)",phylop=3.406,alignable=70,nonprim=46)])
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:2])
axC.bar(cons.region,cons.phylop,color=["#c53030","#d69e2e","#d69e2e","#2f855a"])
axC.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.6); axC.set_ylabel("mean phyloP100way",fontsize=9)
axC.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8); axC.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=8)
axC.set_title("C   Base-level conservation, hg38",fontsize=11,loc="left")
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,2:])
x=np.arange(len(cons))
axD.bar(x-0.2,cons.alignable,0.4,label="all mammals",color="#4a5568")
axD.bar(x+0.2,cons.nonprim,0.4,label="non-primate mammals",color="#d69e2e")
axD.set_xticks(x); axD.set_xticklabels(cons.region,fontsize=8); axD.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=8)
axD.set_ylabel("species with aligned sequence",fontsize=9); axD.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
axD.set_title("D   Ensembl EPO mammals alignment coverage",fontsize=11,loc="left")
fig.suptitle("ITIH5 isoforms 3 and 4 carry no predicted signal peptide, signal anchor or transmembrane segment,\nand their alternative first exons lack the conservation of the canonical signal-peptide exon",
             fontsize=12.5,y=0.975)
plt.show()
